name: Barnacle Bash Silent Disco

name: Saturday Seaside Market

summary: Home-built autonomous boats race a buoy course across the basin.

name: Tidepool Walk with a Marine Biologist
summary: Low tide peaks at 2:40.

name: Harbor Dumpling Brunch Crawl

venueName: Meets at the Fish Box Clock

name: Paint the Lighthouse: Sip and Paint

name: Saltlight Mariners vs. Port Coral FC
summary: The Mariners host their coastal rivals in the last home match of the season.

name: Sea Shanty Singalong at The Rusty Anchor
summary: Lyric sheets on every table, a fiddler and a concertina.

name: Sunday Beach Volleyball Open Play
summary: Show up, get put on a team.

name: Harbor Stories: Film Under the Stars
summary: A giant inflatable screen on the sand plays a classic ocean adventure.

name: Pop the Balloon: Harbor Speed-Friending
summary: New in town or just want more crew? Short rounds of conversation, then pop a balloon to reveal your next question.

name: Sunday Makers' Swap Meet
summary: Trade old microcontrollers, 3D-printer filament, vintage radios and mystery cables.

name: Poetry by the Tide
summary: An open reading on the driftwood benches.

name: Drag Brunch Ahoy!
summary: Mermaid-themed drag numbers, bottomless mimosas and a crab-cake benedict.

name: Boardwalk Pickleball Round-Robin
summary: Paddles provided, partners assigned.

name: Chess on the Boardwalk
summary: A dozen boards set up by the Saltlight Chess Club.

name: Marina's Mission Health-Tech Meetup
summary: Clinicians from Saltlight General pitch real problems; builders pitch prototypes.

name: Twenty Thousand Questions Under the Sea: Trivia
summary: Six rounds of trivia with an ocean-lore bonus round.

summary: Wire up an ultrasonic sensor and log real water levels from the dock.

name: Moonlight Yoga on Lanternfall Beach
summary: A gentle flow on the sand under the rising moon.

name: Coral Reef Restoration Dive
summary: Certified divers help plant coral fragments on the Saltlight artificial reef.

name: Karaoke Night at the Fish Box
summary: Main-stage karaoke with a light-up fish-crate stage.

name: Tech Talk: Sonar, Signals and Machine Learning
summary: A lunch talk on teaching models to tell whales from ship noise.

name: Chef's Table: Seven Courses of the Sea
summary: Chef Ines Marlow cooks seven courses from that morning's catch at a twelve-seat counter.

name: Wednesday Night Sailing Races
summary: Watch from the breakwater or show up at the dock at 5 to crew for a skipper who needs hands.

name: Open Mic at Driftwood Coffee
summary: Singer-songwriters, spoken word and the occasional ukulele.

name: Kids' Shipwright Workshop: Cardboard Boats
summary: Kids design and tape together a cardboard boat, then test it in the float tank.

name: XR Art Night: Paint in Virtual Waves
summary: Sculpt glowing sea creatures in 3D with VR brushes and take home a video of your piece.

name: Harbor Lights Art Walk
summary: Galleries along Barnacle Street stay open late with new shows, live painting and lantern-lit murals.

name: Oyster Shucking 101
summary: Learn to open, grade and slurp three local varieties.

name: The Tempest at the Tidewater Playhouse
summary: Shakespeare's shipwreck comedy staged with real rigging and a water tank at the front of the stage.

name: Deep House at the Deep End
summary: Resident DJs play underwater-themed deep house under a ceiling of blue light.

name: Hardware Hack Night
summary: Open bench night: oscilloscopes, soldering irons and a laser cutter, with mentors on hand.

name: Friday Fish Fry and Bluegrass
summary: Fried catfish, hushpuppies and slaw, with the Heron Creek Pickers on the porch stage.

name: Lantern Festival on the Water
summary: Decorate a paper lantern, write a wish on it and float it out at dusk.

name: Retro Sea Monster Arcade Tournament
summary: Bracket play on a cabinet game about giant squid.

name: Stargazing at Lighthouse Point
summary: The Saltlight Astronomy Club sets up telescopes on the darkest lawn in town.

name: Sustainable Seafood Cooking Class
summary: Cook three dishes from overlooked, sustainable species.

name: Saltlight Maritime Museum
summary: Three floors of shipwreck salvage, ship models and a walk-through whaling boat.

name: Oracle of the Deep Aquarium
summary: A glowing deep-sea aquarium with anglerfish, giant isopods and a jellyfish room lit by an ML model that reacts to the crowd.

name: The Lighthouse Laboratory
summary: A hands-on science center in a converted keeper's house: AR tide tables, a VR submarine and a room of optical illusions under the lamp.

name: Driftglass Gallery
summary: Sea-glass mosaics and coastal photography by local artists.

name: Barnacle Street Mural Alley
summary: A two-block alley of murals: a kraken wrapped around a fire escape, a school of mackerel made of circuit traces, and the famous lighthouse keeper cat.

name: Old Saltlight Lighthouse
summary: Climb 217 steps to the lantern room of the 1871 lighthouse for a 360-degree view of the coast.

name: Gull's Perch Overlook
summary: A cliffside platform with the best sunset view in Saltlight.

name: Tidewater Botanical Gardens
summary: Salt-tolerant gardens, a seaweed greenhouse and a koi pond bridge.

name: Anchor Park
summary: The town green, built around a rusted 4-ton anchor.

name: Kelp Hollow Dog Beach
summary: Off-leash sand for pups, with a rinse station and a snack shack that sells dog ice cream.

name: Tidepool Discovery Beach
summary: Rocky shore with signposted tidepools and a volunteer docent station on weekends.

name: Marina Community Garden
summary: A volunteer-run garden that grows produce for the harbor food pantry.

name: The Rusty Anchor
summary: A dockside pub older than the lighthouse lens.

name: Driftwood Coffee Roasters
summary: Small-batch roaster with long communal tables and fast Wi-Fi.

name: Bytes and Brine Cyber Cafe
summary: Coffee, bubble tea and 300 board games, with gaming PCs in the back.

name: Low Tide Taqueria
summary: Baja fish tacos out of a converted shipping container.

name: The Captain's Table
summary: Saltlight's fine-dining room, with white tablecloths, a harbor view and a menu written each morning from the dayboat catch.

name: Pho Real Noodle House
summary: Steaming bowls of seafood pho and crispy imperial rolls.

name: Sweet Seaweed Vegan Kitchen
summary: Plant-based comfort food: kelp 'crab' cakes, jackfruit po'boys and a miso caramel sundae.

name: Mermaid Scoops
summary: Beachfront ice cream with flavors like salted caramel tide, ube wave and lighthouse lemon.

name: Salt and Smoke BBQ Shack
summary: Smoked brisket and blackened shrimp at picnic tables on the marsh.

name: Brine and Bivalve Oyster Bar
summary: Eight kinds of local oysters on crushed ice, with half-price dozens from 3 to 5.

name: The Crow's Nest Rooftop
summary: Cocktails five stories above the marina with heat lamps and string lights.

name: Siren Song Lounge
summary: A speakeasy behind a fake fishmonger's freezer door.

name: The Deep End
summary: A basement club with a ceiling of shifting blue light that makes the room feel underwater.

name: Fish Box Karaoke
summary: Private karaoke rooms built from old fish-market cold boxes, plus a main stage on weekends.

name: Shipwreck Escape Rooms
summary: Four rooms, from a sinking submarine to a lighthouse keeper's riddle.

name: Kraken Climbing Gym
summary: Bouldering walls shaped like the hull of a ship, with a 15-meter lead wall up the old crane tower.

name: Pixel Pier Arcade
summary: Retro cabinets, rhythm games and skee-ball on a converted pier warehouse.

name: Starboard Lanes
summary: Sixteen lanes of glow-bowling with nautical flags overhead and a surprisingly good crab-fry basket.

name: Harbor Kayak and SUP
summary: Rent a kayak or paddleboard by the hour and explore the calm marsh channels.

name: Lanternfall Cinema
summary: A restored 1930s movie palace with a porthole-lined lobby.

name: Seaside Market Hall
summary: The permanent market under a steel-and-glass roof: fishmongers, flower stalls, spice vendors and forty lunch counters.

name: The Shipyard Makerspace
summary: A community workshop in an old boat shed with 3D printers, CNC, electronics benches and a day pass for visitors.

name: Compass Rose Books and Maps
summary: A creaky bookshop full of sea stories, old charts and a reading nook in a real ship's bow.

name: Salvage and Sons Vintage
summary: Brass portholes, fishermen's sweaters, vintage radios and a bin of mystery keys.

name: Circuit Cove Electronics
summary: Parts store for hardware hackers: sensors, microcontrollers, waterproof enclosures and staff who will debug your wiring.

name: Harbor Ferry Loop
summary: A 50-minute ferry loop past the lighthouse, seal rocks and the shipyard cranes.

name: Lighthouse Ghost Walk
summary: A lantern-lit walk through Saltlight's old quarter and its shipwreck legends, ending at the lighthouse gate at midnight's bell.

name: Sunken Garden Bathhouse
summary: Saltwater soaking pools, a cedar sauna and cold plunges carved into the cliff.

name: Lighthouse Point Loop
summary: An easy loop around the headland with the lighthouse always in view.

name: Oracle Bluffs Ridge Trail
summary: A steady climb along exposed sea cliffs to the Oracle, a rock arch that whistles in the wind.

name: Kelp Hollow Marsh Boardwalk
summary: A flat, stroller-friendly boardwalk over the salt marsh with herons, fiddler crabs and interpretive signs.

name: Shipwreck Cove Coastal Trail
summary: Follows the shoreline to the ribs of the schooner Marigold, visible at low tide.

name: Tidewater Dunes Trail
summary: Sandy trail over rolling dunes with sea oats and a hidden beach at the far end.

name: Mariner's Summit Trail
summary: The hardest climb in the county, up to a fire lookout with a view of three lighthouses on a clear day.

name: Heron Creek Greenway
summary: A paved multi-use path along the creek, popular with runners, cyclists and families on scooters.

name: Lantern Falls Trail
summary: A shaded forest loop to a 20-meter waterfall that glows orange at sunset.

name: Old Rail Causeway
summary: A flat gravel trail on a former rail line across the bay, with water on both sides.

name: Sea Cliff Staircase Challenge
summary: 672 wooden steps straight up the cliff.

name: Driftwood Forest Loop
summary: A loop through a bone-white forest of sun-bleached driftwood trees.

name: Pelican Island Tide Walk
summary: Only walkable two hours either side of low tide: a sandbar crossing to a pelican rookery.

name: Coral Ridge Sunrise Trail
summary: Start in the dark with a headlamp and reach the ridge as the sun comes up out of the ocean.

name: Saltmarsh Birding Loop
summary: A quiet loop with two bird blinds.

name: Kraken's Spine Traverse
summary: An all-day ridgeline scramble over nine rocky knobs.
